scope: Six-region CONUS retrospective weeks 3–4 deterministic calibration pilot; not backbone fine-tuning

provenance.dataset: SubseasonalClimateUSA CFSv2 paired CPC regional pilot
provenance.observation_source: CPC temperature and precipitation 14-day SubseasonalClimateUSA archive
provenance.region_weighting: cos(latitude); identical complete fixed grid for all fields
provenance.anomaly_reference: None in input; trainer fits training-only climatology
provenance.limitations: Retrospective CFSv2 calibration; final revised observations; six correlated regions; no demonstrated operational or ENSO skill; retrospective ENSO sensitivity kept separate; no SST feature acquired.

caveats: One seed and one fixed temporal split; no test-set tuning
Coarse regional means hide local extremes and spatial error; not local forecast validation
No ENSO features: revised MEI is not certified issuance-time vintage
Point forecasts only: no calibrated probabilities, empirical interval coverage, CRPS or reliability claim
Rows share times and spatial dependence; sample count is not independent event count
Historical final verification observations; this is retrospective, not simulated operational retraining
Validation/test years held out from fit; boundaries purged at least 14 days past final training/validation target
Uncertainty/significance of skill differences not established; no robust superiority claim
